losing a loved one is one of life’s most challenging experiences . to help all who know this pain there will be a series of 4 tuesday evening talks on ‘how best to cope after a bereavement’ held in the newman centre, ballina on november 3rd, 10th, 17th and 24th from 8-10pm . the course will be presented by monica morley, bereavement counsellor at knock shrine.

there are a number of waysy can participate, including: reading at mass , leading the prayers of the faithful or bringing up the gifts of bread and wine . this can be especially meaningful at month’s mind or anniversary masses, when family members may wish to take part in remembering and praying for a loved one.
